text: Hi, Professor. Thank you for considering me to be a TA for your class next semester. I’m very interested, but could you give me a little more information about what my responsibilities would be? Sure. As a TA, you would be responsible for leading weekly discussion sections, grading student assignments, and holding review sessions before major exams. Okay, that all sounds good. Would I be able to choose when to hold review sessions? Yes, you would be able to pick when to hold your review sessions, as long as they don’t conflict with class time and you hold them at least a week in advance of each exam. That’s good to know. How many students are usually enrolled in the class? It varies each semester, but it’s typically around thirty students. And how many TAs are there? There are usually two TAs per class. Okay, I appreciate all of the information. I’d love to be your TA. Thanks for giving me this opportunity!
